_comment: Companies confirmed to run public Greenhouse/Lever job boards, grouped loosely by field. Used as a fallback default in ingest.py when GREENHOUSE_BOARDS/LEVER_BOARDS env vars are empty, and as a starting point you can copy from into your .env. Board tokens can go stale if a company migrates ATS providers - verify by visiting boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or jobs.lever.co/<token> before relying on one.
